title: Senior Engineer-Test Automation
description: Why Ryan? Global Award-Winning Culture Flexible Work Environment Generous Paid Time Off World-Class Benefits and Compensation Rapid Growth Opportunities Company Sponsored Two-Way Transportation Exponential Career Growth You will be a critical contributor to an ambitious strategic initiative aimed at re envisioning a broad suite of enterprise level applications. You will ensure the quality, reliability, and performance of software delivered by the development team through a balanced blend of automated and manual testing. Beyond validating functionality, you will champion company standards, continuous improvement, and a culture of quality across the SDLC. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams, and ensure that software solutions align with user needs, business goals, and performance expectations. This role demands hands-on engineering capabilities, a high degree of ownership, and the ability to work independently as well as within a team. Key Responsibilities Test Strategy and Planning Develop, execute, and maintain comprehensive test plans covering functional, integration, regression, and performance scenarios. Translate business and technical requirements into meaningful manual and automated test cases. Provide actionable feedback to Business Analysts to ensure requirements are clear, testable, and traceable. Define and evolve the overall automation strategy aligned with enterprise standards and release cadence. Estimate, prioritize, and plan testing activities in collaboration with Product and Engineering leads. Automation Framework Development Design, implement, and maintain scalable automation frameworks. Integrate tests into continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipelines and ensure fast feedback. Work closely with DevOps to optimize pipeline execution, parallelization of test execution, and environment provisioning. Quality Metrics and Reporting Define key performance indicators (KPIs), including defect leakage, test pass rate, and code coverage, and generate dashboards that guide release-readiness decisions. Drive root-cause analysis sessions for escaped defects and champion preventive actions. Maintain meticulous documentation for all testing activities to ensure auditability and knowledge retention. Collaboration and Execution Partner with application developers to troubleshoot issues and document defects. Work closely with product managers, user experience (UX) designers, and business stakeholders. Contribute to project planning and estimation for features and enhancements. Lead technical discussions, mentor junior engineers, and support knowledge sharing. Own and improve user interface (UI), application programming interface (API), and database automation frameworks to increase coverage and accelerate release cycles. Required Competencies Technical Strength: Deep knowledge of test automation patterns, frameworks, and performance engineering. Ability to debug complex issues across application layers. Solution Ownership: End-to-end accountability for test coverage, environment stability, and release certification. Collaboration and Influence: Clear, concise communication and the ability to advocate for quality in technical forums and executive updates. Execution Excellence: Consistently delivers reliable, maintainable test suites under tight timelines. Continuous Improvement: Proactively introduces tooling, process enhancements, and emerging best practices. What You Bring Six to nine years of experience in software quality engineering with a focus on automation for web and API-based applications. Proficiency in C#/.NET Core, test frameworks such as Selenium, Playwright, and SpecFlow, and API testing tools such as Postman and JMeter. Hands-on experience with CI/CD and Azure or AWS cloud services. Strong SQL skills and experience validating data across relational and NoSQL stores. Proven ability to design, implement, and scale automation frameworks in a collaborative, Agile environment. Excellent written and verbal communication skills and the ability to articulate complex quality risks and solutions. A proactive mindset with the ability to work independently and manage competing priorities. Why Ryan? You’ll be part of a company where innovation meets real-world impact. We’re building something meaningful, and we want your expertise to help shape the future of our platform. Expect a collaborative environment, intelligent peers, and the opportunity to make technical and business decisions that matter.

title: Senior Network Engineer
description: About the Role: Grade Level (for internal use): 10 Network Engineer Global Network Services is seeking a Network Engineer with a strong interest in network automation to help build and operate S&P Global's multi-cloud network platform. This role is central to our drive to replace manual network provisioning with repeatable, code-driven delivery across AWS, Azure and GCP. You will write and extend automation, implement cloud network changes, and support the platform in production - working alongside senior engineers who will guide you on design decisions and review your work. This role suits an engineer who enjoys both writing code and understanding the network it configures, and who wants to grow their cloud networking depth in a large and varied environment. Job Responsibilities Network Automation and Infrastructure-as-Code Write, test and maintain Terraform modules to provision cloud network services across AWS, Azure and GCP, working to patterns set by the senior engineering team. Build scripts and tooling in Python and Ansible to remove repetitive manual network tasks and improve consistency. Extend existing automation to cover new network services and use cases, and help keep shared modules current as cloud platforms evolve. Contribute to CI/CD pipelines for network change, including automated validation and pre-deployment testing. Help develop automated configuration and compliance checks so deviations from approved standards are detected early. Follow good engineering practice in shared repositories - version control, peer review, readable modular code and clear documentation. Identify manual tasks in your own work that could be automated, and propose them to the team. Cloud and Hybrid Networking Implement and support cloud network solutions across AWS, Azure and GCP based on agreed designs and requirements. Configure and maintain core cloud networking components including VPCs and VNets, subnets, Transit Gateway attachments, VPC peering, route tables, security groups, load balancers and DNS. Support hybrid connectivity across AWS Direct Connect, Azure ExpressRoute and site-to-site VPN. Respond to network requests and troubleshoot network failures to diagnose, isolate and resolve issues, escalating to senior engineers where appropriate. Apply routing fundamentals including BGP and OSPF when supporting connectivity between cloud and on-premises environments. Prepare and execute approved network changes within agreed maintenance windows, including documented back-out steps. Collaboration and Continuous Improvement Work with application, security and infrastructure colleagues to deliver network changes that meet enterprise standards and compliance requirements. Produce and maintain low-level documentation, automation runbooks and standard operating procedures. Provide support to operations engineers on network issues, and participate in on-call rotation and out-of-hours change windows as required. title: Senior Cybersecurity Engineer (Center of Excellence)
description: We are looking for a senior OT cybersecurity engineer to join the Grid Automation Cybersecurity Centre of Excellence (COE), a new central team that owns how cybersecurity is executed on GA projects worldwide. The role is hands-on. You will design, build, configure, test and optionally commission security solutions on complex utility and industrial projects. You will then turn that work into the standards, templates and training that regional teams use on every project that follows. You will be the recognized technical owner for a set of solutions in the GA cybersecurity portfolio, covering areas such as firewalls, OT network monitoring, secure remote access, identity, PKI, SIEM, etc... Regional teams will come to you when a project goes beyond their depth. You will also make execution faster and more consistent. That means automating repeatable build and verification work in PowerShell, and using frontier AI models to shorten documentation, requirements mapping and configuration review, while engineering judgement and the protection of customer data stay firmly with you. Job Description About the Cybersecurity COE The COE gives GA a single owner for cybersecurity execution standards and process across all regions. It reports into the GA OT Cybersecurity Product Line and covers five functions: Delivery of complex project scope, and specialist support to regions on demand. A standard execution toolkit: security plans, reference architectures, checklists, templates and automation scripts that regions can apply directly. A structured competency programme of periodic technical and non-technical training. Formal cybersecurity reviews at key project milestones. Regulatory intelligence on IEC 62443, NERC CIP, NIS2, CRA and regional mandates, so execution teams are ready for compliance before customers ask. Roles and Responsibilities Project execution Lead the cybersecurity workstream on Tier 1 projects end to end: requirements review, security architecture, detailed design, build, configuration, FAT, SAT, commissioning and handover. Work hands-on in staging and at customer sites: build and harden Windows and Linux servers, and configure firewalls, Active Directory, PKI, KDC, network intrusion detection, SIEM and syslog, application control, backup and recovery, and secure remote access. Produce the project security deliverables: security plan, zone and conduit model, risk assessment, hardening records, test procedures and reports, and the security handover package. Map customer requirements to contract scope early, flag deviations as they arise, and give project managers the technical basis for change orders. Support tender and project teams with scope definition and effort estimates for complex cybersecurity scope. Execution standards and toolkit Act as the technical owner (Expert) for an assigned set of COE competencies. Set the reference configuration for each and keep it current with product and partner releases. Build the GA execution toolkit as a by-product of delivery: reference architectures, configuration baselines, build checklists, PowerShell scripts, how-to guides, test procedures and templates. Run formal design and configuration reviews at project milestones, so misconfigurations are found before FAT and handover rather than by the customer. Capture lessons learned at project close and feed them back into the toolkit. Automation and AI-assisted execution Write and maintain PowerShell scripts and modules that automate repeatable execution tasks: Windows Server and workstation hardening, Active Directory and Group Policy build, account and group provisioning, certificate enrolment, audit policy and log forwarding setup, and backup job configuration. Build automated checks that compare as-built systems against the COE reference baselines and produce the evidence for milestone reviews, FAT and SAT, so verification no longer depends on manual screenshots and spot checks. Use frontier AI models to speed up execution work: drafting and reviewing security plans, test procedures and as-built documents; mapping customer specifications against IEC 62443-3-3 requirements; analysing firewall rule bases, configuration exports and logs; and writing and reviewing scripts. Use AI only within GE Vernova approved platforms and data-handling rules. Customer configurations, network drawings and logs from critical infrastructure stay inside approved boundaries, and an engineer verifies every AI output before it reaches a customer or a live system. Turn proven scripts, prompts and AI-assisted workflows into toolkit assets, so regional engineers get the same gains on Tier 2 and Tier 3 projects. Competency building Design and deliver structured technical training for regional engineers, from foundation to advanced level, on the solutions you own. Coach regional engineers on live projects, so that project types can move from Tier 1 to Tier 2, and from Tier 2 to Tier 3. Maintain independent working capability (Backup) in competencies owned by COE colleagues, so the team keeps delivering when one person is unavailable. Specialist support and regulatory intelligence Provide on-demand support to regional teams on design questions, site troubleshooting and escalations. Support patch management, vulnerability assessment and incident response engagements on GA-delivered systems, working with Product Security. Track IEC 62443, NERC CIP, NIS2, CRA, IEC 62351 and regional mandates, and translate new requirements into execution checklists and deliverables. Help regional teams answer customer compliance questions that arise during project execution. Product and partner feedback Feed field experience back to Product Management and R&D: integration issues, recurring defects and gaps in the portfolio. Support validation and first deployments of new GA cybersecurity solutions as they come through NPI. Work with technology partners on integration, technical escalations and joint validation. Required Qualifications Bachelor's or master's degree in Electrical, Electronics or Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or equivalent work experience. 8+ years in industrial automation or the energy sector, including at least 5 years delivering OT cybersecurity hands-on on customer projects, from design through commissioning. Applied knowledge of IEC 62443 on real projects, in particular 3-2 (risk assessment, zones and conduits), 3-3 (system security requirements and security levels) and 2-4 (service provider requirements). Working knowledge of NERC CIP, NIS2, CRA, IEC 62351 and NIST guidance, and how each translates into project deliverables. Expert-level, hands-on depth in at least three of the following areas, and working capability in most of the rest: Next-generation firewalls (Fortinet preferred) OT network intrusion detection and monitoring (Nozomi, Dragos or similar) Secure remote access for industrial systems (Xona or similar) Active Directory, Group Policy, RADIUS and LDAP Public key infrastructure and certificate lifecycle management SIEM and syslog collection (Splunk or similar) Centralised security management platforms Application control and host intrusion prevention (Trellix or similar) Backup and disaster recovery Windows and Linux server build, hardening and virtualisation Hardening of IEDs, RTUs, gateways and other field devices Sound understanding of substation and grid automation (protection and control, RTUs, gateways, SCADA and EMS) and the protocols that run them: IEC 61850, DNP3, IEC 60870-5-104 and Modbus. Working proficiency in PowerShell for Windows Server and Active Directory administration: the ActiveDirectory and GroupPolicy modules, remoting, error handling and logging, and running signed scripts under the restricted execution policies typical of OT environments. Practical, regular use of frontier AI models (such as Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini or Microsoft Copilot) in engineering work, with the judgement to check outputs, catch errors and keep sensitive customer data out of unapproved tools. A track record of producing project security documentation that customers and auditors accept. Experience training and mentoring engineers. Willingness to travel 20–40%, including extended site stays, and to join calls across time zones. Desired Characteristics Certifications such as GICSP, GRID, ISA/IEC 62443 Cybersecurity Expert (or its specialist certificates), CISSP, Fortinet FCP or FCSS (formerly NSE 4 and NSE 7), Splunk Core Certified, or vendor training on Nozomi or Dragos. Experience as the cybersecurity lead on large utility, data centre or industrial projects with multiple vendors and a demanding customer. Experience building AI-assisted engineering workflows, such as structured prompt libraries, agent-based tools or API integrations, for document generation, requirements mapping or log triage. Configuration-as-code and scripting discipline: PowerShell DSC or Ansible, Pester tests for scripts, Git version control, and Bash or Python for Linux systems. Writes clear, precise documentation. A checklist or procedure written by this person can be followed by an engineer who has never met them. Teaches well. Can explain a design decision to a junior engineer and defend it to a customer's security team. Holds scope boundaries with customers firmly and professionally, and understands that scope discipline protects both schedule and margin. Works comfortably in a global organisation with people from many cultures and backgrounds. Additional languages are an advantage. Takes ownership. Treats a problem found on one project as a gap in the toolkit, and fixes the toolkit. Additional Information Relocation Assistance Provided: Yes Candidates should be aware that this role involves a client's critical infrastructure; shortlisted candidates would therefore be subject to heightened security checks as directed by our clients. All personal data will be handled with the utmost confidentiality and in accordance with our data protection policies, solely for recruitment and security purposes.

description: Are you a quality engineer who wants to build confidence in a fast-evolving AI agent — not just execute manual test cases?
